text: Why is char unsigned when every other integral type in Java is signed?
choices: There is no such thing as a negative character
Because it makes char faster to compare
It is signed; the range is -32,768 to 32,767
explanation: char runs 0 to 65,535 because a code unit is an index into a character set, and indices are not negative. It does mean char behaves differently from short in arithmetic, which occasionally surprises.
